policy.rationale: An 80-command emergency ceiling includes tenant/session/authorization reads and batched list projection. At fixed pagination, cardinality or a five-row page increase may add at most two batch/empty-page queries. Ten seconds per DB command is an extreme failure ceiling, not a latency SLO. Existing product violations must fail; they are not exempted or used to raise budgets.
policy.durationPolicy: PR blocks only the extreme per-command ceiling; main/nightly emits repeated db.total_time_ms samples for PERF-03 and never creates an approved baseline automatically.

scenarios.currentDebt: Unpaged product collection; inventory and query growth probe only.
ProjectService.ListAsync materializes all visible Projects and performs per-row permission checks.
ProjectService.ListTasksAsync materializes and authorizes all Tasks before pagination.
ConversationService.ListAsync adds last-message/read-state/unread/member queries per Conversation.
DbNotificationService checks current target visibility in batches with per-item resolution.
AnnouncementService.ListAsync reads confirmation state per Announcement.

planChecks.rationale: The canonical Task detail/authorization lookup by Task ID must retain an index equality lookup on its ID on the deterministic medium fixture; equivalent index names are accepted; no blanket Seq Scan ban or exact plan comparison.
